title: Zakee Wheatley Selected In Fifth Round by Carolina Panthers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Zakee Wheatley Selected In Fifth Round by Carolina Panthers
sources.description: Penn State’s top safety from last season is now officially a Carolina Panther, as Zakee Wheatley was selected as the 151st overall pick in the fifth round of the NFL Draft. Throughout his PSU career, Wheatley racked up 223 total tackles and six interceptions as a safety. His pass coverage ability, closing speed, and awareness […]
